_comment: Policy for the Copilot workflows. Dependency updates (copilot-dependency-updates.yml): a branch whose minor is released (tag vX.Y.0 exists) takes patch updates only, an unreleased minor takes minor and patch updates, majors are never proposed. Sonar fixes (copilot-sonar-fix.yml): only a failing quality gate is acted on, fixes may not touch sonarForbiddenFiles and always wait for review.
